results.name: Honolulu
results.why: Mixed tide in the open Pacific at 21°N; a gauge of the nodal comparison in docs/fits.md
results.comment: Vector Average of 5 years, 2014-2018.  Sa, Mm, and Mf from 17 years (1998-2018).

results.name: Kwajalein, Marshall Islands
results.why: Semidiurnal tide on an atoll at 9°N, the lowest latitude; a gauge of the nodal comparison
results.comment: Vector Averaged from 5 years 2014-2018.  Sa, Mm, and Mf from average of 15 years (2000-2018)

results.name: Pago Pago, American Samoa
results.why: The only gauge south of the equator, at 14°S; NOAA's years aren't consecutive
results.comment: Vector Averaged of 5 years (2016-2019, 2022).  MM, MF from 18 year average (2000-2022)  Sa and SSa from 20 year monthly means

results.name: Eastport
results.why: Large semidiurnal tide at the mouth of the Bay of Fundy, M2 2.6 m
results.comment: Vector Average of 5 years (2015-2019).  Sa and SSa from 20 year analysis.

results.name: Boston
results.why: Semidiurnal tide, M2 1.4 m, on a record from 1921
results.comment: Vector Average of 5 years (2015-2019).  Sa and SSa from 20 year Analysis (2000-2019)

results.name: The Battery
results.why: Semidiurnal tide in a harbor at a river's mouth
results.comment: Vector Average of 5 years 2018-2022.   SA and SSA from an average of 16 years 2002-2022.

results.name: Philadelphia
results.why: Tidal river 160 km from the sea, with large shallow-water constituents
results.comment: Vector Average of 5 LSHQA (2016-2020). MM, SSA, Sa, MSF from average of 20 years (2001-2020)

results.name: Baltimore
results.why: Small tide at the head of an estuary, M2 0.15 m, under large weather-driven levels
results.comment: Vector Average of 5 years (2017-2021).  Sa and SSa from average of 19 years (2001-2021). Other long period constituents are not stable.

results.name: Sewells Point
results.why: Semidiurnal tide at the mouth of Chesapeake Bay
results.comment: Vector Average of 5 years LSQHA (2015-2019).  Sa and SSa from 19 vector average of 19 years (2000-2019).

results.name: Charleston
results.why: Semidiurnal tide on the South Atlantic Bight, on a record from 1901
results.comment: Vector Average of 5 years LSQHA (2017-2021).  Sa and SSa from average of 18 years (2001-2021).

results.name: Key West
results.why: Small mixed tide between the Atlantic and the Gulf of Mexico
results.comment: Vector Average of 5 years (2018-2022).  Sa and Ssa from 20 year monthly means analysis (2002-2022),  Mf from average of 20 year annual analysis.

results.name: Pensacola
results.why: Diurnal tide in the Gulf of Mexico; a gauge of the nodal comparison
results.comment: Vector average of 5 years (2018-2022).  Sa and Ssa from 20 year monthly analysis (2002-2022).

results.name: Grand Isle
results.why: Diurnal tide on the Mississippi delta; NOAA's years run to the latest
results.comment: Vector Average of 5 years (2021-2025).  Sa and SSa from average of 16 years (2006-2025).

results.name: Galveston Pier 21
results.why: Mixed, mainly diurnal tide in a bay on the western Gulf of Mexico
results.comment: Vector average of 5 years (2021-2025).  Ssa and Sa from 19 one-year LSQHA analyses between 2006-2025.

results.name: San Diego
results.why: Mixed tide on the Pacific coast at 33°N, on a record from 1906
results.comment: Vector Average of 5 years (2017-2021). Sa from average of 20 years (2002-2021), other long period constituents are unstable.

results.name: South Beach
results.why: Mixed tide on the open Pacific coast at 45°N; an earlier analysis, of six years
results.comment: Mean of six 1-year LSQHA (2007-2012).  Sa and Ssa from 20 years of MSL (1994-2013). Mf from mean of six LSQHA (2007-2012).

results.name: Friday Harbor
results.why: Mixed, mainly diurnal tide in the Salish Sea, K1 0.76 m
results.comment: 6 Year Vector Averaged (2011-2016).  Sa, SSa, and MF from 20 years (1997-2016).

results.name: Anchorage
results.why: The largest tide, M2 3.5 m at 61°N, with ice in winter; NOAA publishes 120 constituents
results.comment: 5-year (2012-2016) Vector Averaged.  Mm, Msf, Mf from average of 20 years (1996-2016).  Sa and SSa from 20year analysis.

results.name: Unalaska
results.why: Mixed, mainly diurnal tide in the Aleutians at 54°N
results.comment: Vector Average of 5 years (2020-2024).  Sa and Mf from mean of 18 years (2005-2024).

results.name: Charlotte Amalie
results.why: Small mixed, mainly diurnal tide in the Caribbean, K1 0.08 m
results.comment: Average of 6 LSQHA (2007-2012).  Sa and SSa from 20 year analyses (1993-2012).  Mm and Msf are not used.
